usageNotes: Returns the top-level index of SDN fabric subdirectories available in the cluster. Use this as a discovery call to enumerate fabric types before drilling into specific fabric configurations. Requires the SDN.Audit privilege on /sdn/fabrics; SDN must be enabled in the cluster (Datacenter > SDN).
tips: SDN fabrics is a newer subsystem; this endpoint may return an empty array on clusters that have not configured any fabrics.
Use get_cluster_sdn to get the parent SDN index and confirm SDN is active before calling fabric-specific endpoints.
API tokens need SDN.Audit on /sdn/fabrics explicitly — cluster-level Admin does not automatically inherit SDN privileges in all PVE versions.
